one_line: Imperial Pandya king who expanded his realm across South India in the mid-13th century CE.

appearance.age_look: Late 30s, athletic and regal build, medium height with sturdy shoulders.
appearance.face: Oval face with warm medium-brown South Indian complexion, straight nose, sharp jawline, neatly trimmed moustache, calm intense eyes with slightly arched brows, default expression composed and dignified with a subtle commanding confidence.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair parted at the center, pulled back into a smooth low knot at the nape; front kept tidy with no loose strands; adorned with a gold Pandya-style cylindrical crown-band encircling the head, set with small red and green stone motifs and a simple central leaf-shaped ornament above the forehead.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate royal Pandya attire: an ankle-length cream-coloured dhoti of fine cotton, pleated in front and wrapped firmly at the waist, bordered with a deep maroon and gold weave; over the torso a fitted, short-sleeved golden-yellow angavastra-style upper cloth, draped diagonally from left shoulder across the chest and secured at the right hip, with subtle floral motifs in dull gold thread; a second, narrower maroon silk sash runs from right shoulder to left hip, signifying royal rank; feet in simple brown leather sandals; arms adorned with thick gold armlets on both upper arms, multiple gold bangles on wrists, and a broad gold necklace with a central teardrop pendant; small gold stud earrings and a thin gold waist-belt with a tiny central medallion; a faint vertical sandalwood tilak on the forehead, flanked lightly by turmeric marks, mirroring temple devotion.
appearance.signature: A long, slightly curved steel sword in a plain brown leather scabbard with subtle gold fittings, worn at his left hip; when drawn, the sword has a simple disc pommel and crossguard, sized for one-handed use, symbolizing his campaigns and royal authority.

ref_desc: Jatavarman Sundara Pandyan I is a late-30s medium-brown South Indian king with black hair in a low knot, gold Pandya crown-band, cream dhoti with maroon-gold border, golden-yellow draped upper cloth, maroon sash, gold jewellery, and a curved steel sword at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style royal South Indian man in his late 30s, medium-brown skin, oval face, calm intense eyes, neat moustache, and thick black hair pulled into a smooth low knot at the nape, wearing a gold Pandya cylindrical crown-band with small red and green stone motifs and a central leaf ornament above the forehead. Show him in historically accurate 13th-century Pandya attire: an ankle-length cream cotton dhoti with deep maroon and gold border, tightly wrapped with front pleats, a fitted golden-yellow angavastra-style upper cloth draped diagonally from left shoulder to right hip with subtle floral gold thread patterns, and a narrow maroon silk sash crossing from right shoulder to left hip. Include brown leather sandals, thick gold armlets on both upper arms, multiple gold bangles, a broad gold necklace with a teardrop pendant, small gold stud earrings, a thin gold waist-belt with a small central medallion, and a vertical sandalwood tilak with light turmeric marks on his forehead. At his left hip, show a long slightly curved steel sword in a plain brown leather scabbard with gold fittings, designed for one-handed use, clearly visible as his signature weapon. Use cream, maroon, golden yellow, brown, and black as the dominant colours, and pose him standing straight, dignified and composed, as a character model sheet with clear front-facing view capturing face, hair, costume, jewellery, sandals, and sword consistently.
